facts: Parties: Penrith Capital LLP (Buyer), Hartwell Marine Ltd (Seller); the Company is Yarrow Analytics Ltd.
This Agreement is dated 23 December 2026; Closing is scheduled for 26 March 2027 (the 'Closing Date').

Section 1.1: 'Material Adverse Change' means any event which has a material adverse effect on the business of the Company, excluding changes in general economic conditions, changes affecting the industry generally, and pandemics.
Section 3.4 (Earn-out): the Earn-out Payment equals 2 times the amount by which FY2026 EBITDA exceeds $4,000,000, capped at $5,000,000.

Disclosure against Warranty 8.2 (IP): the Company's core platform software was developed in 2023 by an independent contractor, Whitlock Technologies Ltd. No written assignment of intellectual property was entered into.
Management accounts show FY2026 EBITDA of $4,800,000; the Seller says the Earn-out Payment will therefore be $2,200,000.
Item 5: the board noted a letter before action from Kestrel Industries Ltd threatening proceedings for approximately $450,000 in respect of alleged defective deliveries. Management to monitor.
Present: 2 directors (of 5). The meeting was quorate. RESOLVED to approve entry into the Share Purchase Agreement.
Article 11: the quorum for board meetings is three directors.
